text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Tallinn city court declared Tiit Madisson guilty of trying to prepare a state coup and sentenced him to two years in jail.
- The border guard department suspects that the 14 men from India, recently smuggled to Sweden from Estonia, had contacts with an international smuggling groupo.
- The customs department has dismissed 29 inspectors this year for accepting bribes and has started criminal cases against some of them.
- Parliament started the first reading of the law on state merits.

- A drill for a special police unit aimed at dealing with terrorist attacks was held in the Hansapank building in central Tallinn. It included the evacuation of people from the building by helicopter.
- A lorry with 25 defence force conscripts overturned when speeding, nine of the men were hurt.
